notes: «حدثنا أبي» is a relation (the father of the second ابن نمير): not merged with عبد الله بن نمير (rule 9); the two branches meet there and the text writes the tail once
«قال قام سهل بن حنيف ... فقال أيها الناس» : Sahl's own words are relayed, so سهل is the last link
Umar's speech and the Prophet's answers inside the account are scene, not links
«- وتقاربا في اللفظ -» is an editor's gloss: left out
